raw.title: (Senior) SEO Manager / SEO Projekt Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Wir sind findling – eine Agentur mit klarem Fokus auf Suchmaschinenoptimierung.

SEO klingt im ersten Moment nach einem sehr spezialisierten Bereich, ist in der Praxis aber extrem vielseitig. Denn in unserer täglichen Arbeit kommen Marketing, Technik, Datenanalyse, Content und Kundenberatung zusammen.

Unser Ziel: Wir helfen Unternehmen und den Menschen dahinter zu wachsen, indem wir Informationen so aufbereiten, dass sie online besser gefunden werden und möglichst viele Menschen erreichen.

Dabei wachsen auch wir – als Unternehmen, als Team und als Persönlichkeiten. Jeden Tag. Und weil wir noch viel vorhaben, suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Projekte aktiv zu steuern und gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Was uns ausmacht?

Wir sind ein Team, das ehrlich und authentisch miteinander umgeht, viel Eigenverantwortung gibt und gleichzeitig einen klaren Anspruch an Leistung und Ergebnisse hat. Bei uns gibt es keine starren Hierarchien, aber auch keine halbe Sachen. Wir wollen Menschen, die eigene Ideen einbringen, selbstständig arbeiten und Verantwortung übernehmen.

Unser Anspruch ist hoch: Wir arbeiten fokussiert, wertschätzend und auf Augenhöhe. Dafür gibt es echte Gestaltungsspielräume, Raum für konzentriertes Arbeiten und persönliche Entwicklung.

Du solltest Freude daran haben, in einem abwechslungsreichen Agenturumfeld anzupacken: mit mehreren Kunden, unterschiedlichen Branchen, parallelen Projekten und dem klaren Willen, Qualität, Struktur und Fortschritt jeden Tag aktiv voranzubringen.

Deine Rolle

Als (Senior) SEO Manager / SEO Projektmanager (m/w/d) betreust du nicht nur einzelne SEO-Maßnahmen, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, priorisierst sinnvoll, steuerst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass aus Analysen, Strategien und Empfehlungen konkrete Ergebnisse werden.

Du bist fachlicher Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, denkst strategisch mit und setzt deine Ideen gleichzeitig selbst um: Statt nur zu delegieren, arbeitest du direkt in der operativen Umsetzung mit und behältst dabei To-dos, Timings und Projektziele im Blick.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich mehrere SEO-Projekte parallel und behältst Ziele, Timings, Prioritäten und nächste Schritte im Blick
  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für deine Kundenprojekte und sorgst als zentrale Schnittstelle für eine klare, verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Du entwickelst individuelle SEO-Strategien, insbesondere für E-Commerce-Kunden, dabei leitest aus Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Website-Analysen konkrete Maßnahmen ab
  • Du setzt SEO-Maßnahmen selbstständig und praktisch um – von der technischen Optimierung über Onpage-Anpassungen bis hin zur Erstellung konkreter Content-Briefings und Vorgaben für unser Content-Team
  • Du planst, steuerst und monitorst SEO-Kampagnen und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen zuverlässig umgesetzt werden – auch durch dich Selbst
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) und entwickelst Strategien sowie konkrete Ansätze, um Kundeninhalte für KI-gestützte Suchumgebungen wie ChatGPT & Co. sichtbarer zu machen
  • Du bereitest Reportings, Status-Updates und Ergebnispräsentationen vor und erklärst Entwicklungen sowie nächste Schritte verständlich und beratungsstark
  • Du verbindest SEO-Fachwissen mit Projektsteuerung, Kundenkommunikation und Umsetzungsstärke

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im SEO-Bereich, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Umfeld mit mehreren parallelen Projekten
  • Du bist es gewohnt, mehrere Kunden, Themen und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu betreuen
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in Onpage SEO, Offpage SEO und Content Marketing mit und setzt Maßnahmen auch selbst um
  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für E-Commerce, Websites, Content-Strukturen und technische SEO-Grundlagen
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Kundenkommunikation und trittst professionell, verbindlich und beratungsstark auf
  • Du kannst Projekte strukturieren, To-dos priorisieren und eigenständig vorantreiben
  • Du denkst nicht nur in Analysen, sondern auch in Umsetzung, Wirkung und Ergebnissen
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, organisiert und lösungsorientiert
  • Du kannst relevante Referenzseiten vorweisen und konkret erläutern, mit welchen Maßnahmen du die Sichtbarkeit verbessert hast
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GEO ist wünschenswert; wichtiger ist, dass du die zunehmende Bedeutung von KI-gestützten Suchumgebungen wie ChatGPT etc. für SEO verstehst, diese Entwicklung mitdenkst und bereit bist, dich bei sich ändernden Anforderungen schnell und intensiv einzuarbeiten
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Die Stelle passt zu dir, wenn du …

  • gerne Verantwortung für Kundenprojekte übernimmst
  • Abwechslung durch verschiedene Kunden, Branchen und Fragestellungen schätzt
  • Agenturarbeit kennst oder Lust auf ein Umfeld hast, in dem mehrere Projekte parallel laufen
  • strukturiert arbeitest und auch bei vielen Themen den Überblick behältst

  • SEO strategisch denkst, aber pragmatisch in die Umsetzung bringst
  • Freude daran hast, Projekte aktiv zu führen statt nur einzelne Aufgaben abzuarbeiten

Benefits

Unabhängig von deiner Rolle erwarten dich bei uns viele Freiheiten und Besonderheiten, die vielleicht noch nicht überall selbstverständlich sind – für uns aber sehr gut funktionieren:

  • 100 % Remote Work innerhalb Deutschlands: Arbeite dort, wo du am produktivsten bist
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Ob Frühaufsteher oder Langschläfer – du findest deinen Rhythmus
  • Hochwertige Hardware: Apple MacBook & Co., auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Steuersparcard: Monatlicher steuerfreier Sachbezug nach der Probezeit
  • Weiterbildung & Entwicklung: Workshops sowie interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Eigenverantwortung & Wachstum: Eine stabile, wachsende Agentur mit klarer Vision und Raum für deine Ideen
  • Onsite-Events & Team-Treffen: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Events für echten Teamgeist trotz Remote Setup
  • Bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vieles mehr

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Viel Abwechslung UGC, Comedy, Interviews, Produktvideos, KI-Content, organische TikToks und hochwertige Produktionen gehören bei uns gleichermaßen zum Alltag. with the rest of Grafana, and profiles that work for operational and SRE workflows, not just performance specialists.</p> <p>Over the next year, you will help us:</p> <ul> <li>Ship Adaptive Profiles as the default ingestion strategy, so customers automatically collect the profiles they need at a cost that makes sense.</li> <li>Turn Pyroscope into a platform capability inside Grafana: bi-directional trace-to-profile correlation, integration with Kubernetes Monitoring and App Observability, and profiles surfaced where engineers already start their investigations.</li> <li>Prepare Pyroscope for an agent-driven world: APIs, CLI, and docs designed so AI agents can drive profiling end to end, covering the full performance optimization lifecycle from finding an issue to verifying title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business. This is an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa. The Impact – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍 The Opportunity 🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership 🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026) 🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year-on-year, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing 🌱 Real climate impact: Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents What You'll Do At M-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa. Technical Environment 💻 Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker Observability: Prometheus, Grafana Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery AI tooling: We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow Our Engineering Approach 🚀 As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on: High quality output Observability and monitoring Automated testing in all environments, including production Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices What You Need We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development. description: Are you an experienced railway professional with knowledge and experience of roles like COSS, ES and PICOP? You already understand the track and the people who work on it. We're looking for people like you to help put new safety technology into the hands of the workforce - and to be part of a big change in how track workers are kept safe. At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that transform rail worker safety. Our geofencing solution has been named one of TIME's Best Inventions and has made the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. It's already out there on the track, helping to keep people away from the running line and improving on site efficiency. Network Rail is committed to geofencing for the long term, and the rollout across the Sussex region is already underway. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to help us grow our capability on the ground. Tasks As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between Tended and our clients, guiding their teams through helping their teams get comfortable using our kit out on-site. You'll lead key client deployments on the ground, working closely with Tended's project managers to deliver an excellent service. Success in this role depends on building strong, trusting relationships quickly - so first-class communication and interpersonal skills are essential. Our technology is used by track workers with a wide range of technical confidence. You'll develop a deep understanding of our products so you can coach users through their day-to-day challenges and until they’re confident using it on their own. Being on-site also puts you in a unique position to see how our products are really used - spotting ideas for how we can make it better and feeding improvements back to the team. You'll need strong knowledge of the rail environment and the roles within it, and you'll either hold a Personal Track Safety (PTS) qualification or meet the requirements to obtain one. Above all, we're looking for someone proactive and approachable - person fit matters to us.** Travel and working pattern This is a field-based role centred on regular client site visits across the Sussex region. You'll spend at least 3 days a week in the depot and on site, with the remaining time working remotely or in person with your line manager. Because our users work shifts, this role covers both nightshifts and dayshifts, and includes weekend and bank holiday working - flexibility to meet the needs of the business and our clients is essential. In return, we have excellent policies covering travel, accommodation and subsistence expenses, as well as fatigue management and time off in lieu. A full driving licence is required. Requirements Even if you don’t feel you have all of the requirements listed below, we’d encourage you to apply, as we’re looking for someone who is willing to learn and grow with us. Essential You have experience as an ES, ESA, COSS, Site Agent, or in a comparable on-site leadership role within the railway or a related industry. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, with an ability to influence site teams and users, and turn them into capable users of our product. Experience of working with different roles, from track workers to site managers is desirable. You are comfortable with technology and enthusiastic to develop an in-depth understanding of our products to provide on-site coaching and support to users. You take a detailed approach and consistently follow established processes and procedures with accuracy. You instinctively take initiative to find and fix problems, thinking out of the box to find ways to make things better. Desirable You might have practical, hands-on experience of on-the-ground delivery of new technologies, delivering to a range of different kinds of users with different levels of tech-savviness. You might have experience with project management tools. You might have some experience in project management disciplines such as planning, managing risks, dependencies, issues, timelines, budgets, scope, deliverables and quality. You might have some commercial awareness, such as understanding how to demonstrate the value of our work to clients during delivery. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In this role, you will:

An ideal candidate also has:

We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

About Bike Club

Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

Tasks

The Role

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Head of Retention to build and lead Bike Club's retention capability across the UK and Germany.

You will own retention strategy and performance across the member lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, bike exchange, cancellation prevention, referral, additional memberships and win-back. You will build this capability from a relatively limited existing base and work directly in tools such as Salesforce and Klaviyo.

Retention will own lifecycle strategy, customer journeys, segmentation, triggers, propositions and performance. You will partner with the Head of Content on messaging, and work closely with Acquisition, Product, Customer Support, Operations, Finance and shared data support.

What You'll Do

Retention Strategy

  • Develop and deliver a clear retention strategy for Bike Club across UK and Germany.
  • Build a clear roadmap for improving customer lifetime value across the subscription lifecycle.
  • Build the retention capability essentially from scratch, given the limited existing base to build from.

CRM & Lifecycle Management

  • Own lifecycle strategy from joining and onboarding through engagement, exchange, continued membership, cancellation and win-back.
  • Design and implement customer journeys, segmentation, triggers, channel cadence and offers in Salesforce, Klaviyo and other relevant systems.
  • Design and own lifecycle communications that deliver the right message to the right customer at the right time.
  • Develop interventions to reduce early-life churn, voluntary cancellations and involuntary churn such as failed payments.
  • Maintain high standards for CRM data quality, consent, preferences and email deliverability.

Member-Get-Member, Referral & Community

  • Design, launch and optimise member-get-member (MGM) and referral activity across both markets.
  • Identify opportunities to increase member value through exchanges, additional memberships and other relevant propositions.
  • Set targets and incentive structures that balance customer value, growth, cost and margin.
  • Define the purpose and objectives of any member community activity; partner with Content on the content plan and country teams on day-to-day engagement.

Customer Insight, Data & AI

  • Use cohort analysis to understand behaviour and churn by tenure, bike, brand, acquisition source, market and other relevant characteristics.
  • Work closely with the business's shared central data resource to access the reporting and insight retention needs.
  • Use AI-enabled tools appropriately to accelerate segmentation, analysis, personalisation and lifecycle optimisation.
  • Work with Product, Technology, Operations and Customer Success to address root causes of churn, not only communication symptoms.

Requirements

You'll be a hands-on, data-literate retention or lifecycle specialist who is comfortable building a capability from a limited base, and who is genuinely confident working directly in CRM and lifecycle tools. You'll bring:

  • Strong commercial acumen - commercial capability is critical to success in every marketing role at Bike Club.
  • A genuine passion for people - you see developing and leading your team as critical to building Bike Club's culture, and you'll operate as a member of our extended Senior Leadership Team.
  • Senior experience leading retention, lifecycle, CRM or loyalty within a consumer or subscription business.
  • Hands-on, practical experience working directly in Salesforce, Klaviyo or comparable CRM/lifecycle platforms.
  • A strong track record of building or scaling onboarding, cancellation prevention, win-back, referral, member-get-member or community programmes.
  • Strong data literacy, comfortable interpreting cohort and customer behaviour data directly to shape activity.
  • Experience with, or interest in, customer community management is a plus.
  • A test-and-learn mindset and the ability to move from insight to execution.
  • Strong cross-functional and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working across multiple markets is desirable. German-language capability is advantageous but not essential.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Built a clear, prioritised retention strategy and capability for Bike Club, essentially from scratch.
  • Established reliable lifecycle, churn, exchange and cohort reporting.
  • Improved onboarding and early-life engagement and reduced avoidable churn.
  • Established CRM and lifecycle management as a well-run, data-led discipline, hands-on in Salesforce and Klaviyo.
  • Launched or scaled member-get-member, referral and win-back activity.
  • Built a strong working partnership with Acquisition, Content, Product, Operations, Customer Success, Finance and the shared data resource.

Benefits

  • Remote first – work from anywhere in the UK. You will be required to attend a in person meetings as needed
  • Holidays – 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with additional days accrued for each year worked
  • Private health insurance - via Vitality
  • Bike subscription – £30/month discount towards Bike Club subscription

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is a rare opportunity to build a retention function from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club builds long-term relationships with families.

The signal is evidence you helped define the right problem, not just made the screens.</li> <li><strong>Visual craft.</strong> Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. Judgement spent where it counts.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>The full stack</strong></h5> <p>We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.</p> <ul> <li>Your own research and usability testing.</li> <li>Validation and experimentation. You set up A/B tests and read them honestly.</li> <li>UX writing. In a regulated market, this is craft and compliance at once.</li> <li>Problem definition. Break it down. Package it back up.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Your portfolio</strong></h5> <p>Show problem solving that moved a commercial lever, not just well-made screens. How you write it says as much as what you show. Concise and clear is a signal of how you communicate. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.</p> <h5><strong>Experience</strong></h5> <p>Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of owning problems end to end and influencing direction at a team level.</p> <h4><strong>Behaviours &amp; attitude</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Patient-first mindset.</strong> You put patient outcomes first. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative creation. </strong>You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity. </strong>You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.</li> </ul> </div> <h3><strong>Why join Eucalyptus?</strong></h3> <p>Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (<a href="https://pilot.com.au/">Pilot,</a>&nbsp;<a href="http://www.kinfertility.com.au/">Kin</a>,&nbsp;<a href="http://skin.software/">Software</a>) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>What’s next</strong> - Our goal for the next three years is to support <strong>1 million patients globally</strong> to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Build something world-changing</strong> - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks &amp; Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. title: Senior Electronics & Systems Engineer
description: Join ONI and Explore the Boundaries of Scientific Discovery!   At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Scope stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. We are actively seeking an enthusiastic and self-motivated Senior Electronics & Systems Engineer to join our pioneering team located in Oxford. We believe in the power of relentless curiosity and the pursuit of excellence, and we invite you to join us in shaping the future of scientific exploration and healthcare breakthroughs. In this role you will be the go-to technical resource for electronics design, working closely with engineering, software and R&D product teams. Electronics design is at the core of the role, but we are looking for someone who enjoys working beyond the boundaries of the PCB - developing embedded firmware, integrating sensors and actuators, and understanding how electronics interact with optics, mechanics, software and the physical world. You will have significant technical ownership across the product lifecycle, from circuit and system design through prototyping, bring-up, verification and production. You will also develop production firmware and work further up the software stack where needed to integrate, automate and test the systems you develop. The role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex multidisciplinary problems, takes ownership of product outcomes and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Your role at ONI: Own electronics designs from concept through architecture, schematic design, PCB development, bring-up, verification and production. Design robust analogue and digital electronics, including power supplies, signal conditioning, sensor interfaces, communications and control electronics. Make appropriate component and architecture choices, balancing performance, cost, availability, manufacturability and product requirements. Undertake PCB design and layout as an integral part of electronics development, working with external PCB designers where appropriate, and considering signal integrity, grounding, noise, EMC/ESD, thermal performance and DFM/DFT. Work with manufacturing partners and suppliers to ensure designs are manufacturable, testable and robust through production. Bring up new hardware and systematically debug complex problems using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, hardware debuggers and other laboratory instrumentation. Develop and maintain production embedded firmware, typically for microcontrollers, alongside low-level firmware for hardware bring-up, control, test and diagnostics. Develop and debug interfaces to sensors, actuators and other hardware, including analogue front ends, ADCs/DACs and common digital communication interfaces. Work with optical and mechanical engineers on optoelectronic and physical-system interfaces, such as photodetectors, lasers and other light sources, cameras, position and temperature sensing, motors, piezos and other actuators. Diagnose issues whose root cause may lie in electronics, firmware, sensors, optics, mechanics, cabling, software or the interactions between them. Develop test and automation tools, including Python-based instrumentation, hardware testing and manufacturing QA. Support verification, EMC/compliance testing, production test, calibration and transfer of designs into manufacture. Support electronics throughout the product lifecycle, including investigation of product and manufacturing issues, root-cause analysis, component obsolescence and design changes. Apply modern software engineering practices including source control, automated testing and CI/CD, and make effective use of AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to extend and accelerate your capabilities beyond electronics. We'd expect experience in many of the following: Strong analogue and digital circuit design fundamentals. Schematic capture, PCB layout and development of multilayer PCBs. Power supply design, power distribution, protection and power sequencing. Low-noise electronics, grounding, shielding and signal integrity. Sensor interfacing, analogue signal conditioning, amplification, filtering and data conversion. Microcontrollers and embedded systems. Embedded C/C++, including development of robust production firmware and low-level peripheral control, interrupts, timers, DMA and real-time behaviour. Developing from device datasheets and MCU/SoC reference manuals rather than relying solely on high-level libraries. Interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, USB and Ethernet. Practical board bring-up and fault-finding using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters and hardware debuggers. Design for EMC, ESD, reliability, manufacturability and test. Taking electronics through prototype, verification, certification and production. Git and modern software development practices, and Python or similar for test, automation and instrumentation. Working effectively across electronics, firmware, mechanical, optical and higher-level software disciplines. Additional desirable experience includes: Scientific instrumentation, microscopy, imaging or other precision instruments. Optoelectronics, including photodiodes, LEDs/lasers, optical power monitoring or camera/image-sensor interfaces. Precision or low-noise analogue electronics. Motion control, motors, encoders, piezo actuators or feedback/control systems. High-speed data acquisition or communications. Production test fixtures, calibration systems and manufacturing automation. System-level debugging across complex multidisciplinary systems, including electronics, firmware, optics, mechanics and software. Using coding agents or other AI-assisted development tools to build test, automation or hardware-control applications. At ONI, we understand that a fulfilling career involves more than just challenging work - it's about enjoying a well-rounded experience. When you become a part of our team, you not only contribute to groundbreaking research but also enjoy a range of benefits designed to enhance your life both inside and outside the workplace.   As an equal opportunity employer, we prioritize fairness and respect, ensuring every team member thrives regardless of their background. But that's not all - our perks include: Competitive Compensation: We recognize and reward your talent. Enjoy a competitive salary that reflects your expertise and contributions, ensuring your hard work is recognized. 28 days of annual leave plus 8 bank holidays and 4 dedicated wellbeing days. Onsite Gym Facilities: Stay active and energized with our convenient onsite gym, promoting your overall health. Private Healthcare and Dental Coverage: Your health matters to us. Access top-notch medical and dental services, ensuring your well-being is in good hands. Inclusive Culture: Be a valued member of our diverse, inclusive family. Your unique perspective is celebrated here, fostering a culture of mutual respect and understanding. Cycle To Work Scheme: Embrace a sustainable commute with our cycle to work program, promoting eco-friendly travel and a healthy lifestyle. Health Assured: Your mental health is essential. Access our comprehensive mental health support services for a balanced work-life experience. People’s Pension: Secure your future with our pension scheme, investing in your financial well-being beyond the workplace. Perks at Work: Enjoy exclusive discounts and deals through our perks at work program, adding value to your everyday life. Specsavers Eyecare: Your vision matters. Benefit from our eyecare program with Specsavers, ensuring your eyes stay healthy and your vision clear. If you are driven by innovation, eager to make a significant impact in the realm of scientific and medical research, and possess the skills and passion we are looking for, we invite you to apply and be a part of our mission to improve our understanding of the details of life. title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
description: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal Mainstone Vets - Romsey, Hampshire  Salary up to £70,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 and Relocation Allowance up to £5,000    At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.     Mainstone Practice, part of ivc, is a long-established senior veterinary surgery in Romsey, proudly caring for the local community for many years. We’re looking for a confident Veterinary Surgeon to join our warm and supportive team, where relationships, continuity of care and genuine teamwork are at the heart of what we do. As a senior vet, you’ll also have the chance to contribute your ideas and help shape how the practices develop as they move into this exciting next chapter however we are also open to candidates looking for a vet surgeon opportunity.  A Varied Role With Plenty of Clinical Interest   Our caseload is predominantly cats and dogs, alongside rabbits, small furries and the occasional wildlife patient, from hedgehogs to birds of prey. You’ll enjoy a good balance of consultations and surgery, with plenty of routine first-opinion work alongside orthopaedics and occasional emergency and critical care cases. There are elements of sole charge, so we’re looking for a vet who is confident making independent clinical decisions while knowing support is always available when needed.   Facilities That Help You Do Your Best Work   We’ve invested heavily in our facilities, including comprehensive IDEXX in-house laboratory equipment, dental radiography, a dedicated dental suite, floating X-ray table, multiparameter monitoring, Doppler blood pressure monitoring, syringe drivers and multiple infusion pumps. We’re also Silver Cat Friendly, with dedicated cat-only consultation times to help create a calmer experience for our feline patients.   A Practice That Feels Like Home   Set within a charming barn conversion, Mainstone is bright, welcoming and thoughtfully designed. We have separate cat and dog waiting areas, three consultation rooms, a dedicated RVN consult room, theatre and prep area, separate X-ray room, cattery and kennels, quiet vet office, fully equipped laboratory, a relaxing staff area, and generous on-site parking.   A Team That Supports You   You’ll join six vets, six RVNs and a dedicated Client Care Team, including certificate holders in ophthalmology and ECC. We’re an RVN training practice and actively support our team with learning and development, including progression towards clinical certificates.   A Rota That Works Around Life   The role is 40 hours per week, worked between 8:30am and 7pm, with 1:5 Saturday mornings, 8:30am–12:30pm. There’s no out-of-hours work, and part-time applications over 30+ hours are welcomed.   Part of the Romsey Community   Community is important to us, from the Romsey Show and Dogstival to local schools, Brownies, open days and the New Forest Show. Romsey is a charming market town on the edge of the New Forest, offering the perfect blend of countryside living and modern convenience. With independent shops, cafés, riverside walks and excellent local schools, it’s a wonderful place to settle. The nearby New Forest National Park provides endless opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor adventures, while Southampton and Winchester are within easy reach for city amenities and transport links.     How We’ll Support You   At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:   * Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership, and specialist roles * Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses * £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet * Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches, and peer networks * Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities * A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement   What We Offer Our Team   * 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays * Private medical insurance * Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy * BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees * Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies) * Retail discounts and cashback offers * Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets   We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.   Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow. raw.title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
raw.description:
Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
Mainstone Vets - Romsey, Hampshire 
Salary up to £70,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 and Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 

 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
 

Mainstone Practice, part of ivc, is a long-established senior veterinary surgery in Romsey, proudly caring for the local community for many years. We’re looking for a confident Veterinary Surgeon to join our warm and supportive team, where relationships, continuity of care and genuine teamwork are at the heart of what we do.

As a senior vet, you’ll also have the chance to contribute your ideas and help shape how the practices develop as they move into this exciting next chapter however we are also open to candidates looking for a vet surgeon opportunity. 


A Varied Role With Plenty of Clinical Interest

 


Our caseload is predominantly cats and dogs, alongside rabbits, small furries and the occasional wildlife patient, from hedgehogs to birds of prey.


You’ll enjoy a good balance of consultations and surgery, with plenty of routine first-opinion work alongside orthopaedics and occasional emergency and critical care cases. There are elements of sole charge, so we’re looking for a vet who is confident making independent clinical decisions while knowing support is always available when needed.

 


Facilities That Help You Do Your Best Work

 


We’ve invested heavily in our facilities, including comprehensive IDEXX in-house laboratory equipment, dental radiography, a dedicated dental suite, floating X-ray table, multiparameter monitoring, Doppler blood pressure monitoring, syringe drivers and multiple infusion pumps.


We’re also Silver Cat Friendly, with dedicated cat-only consultation times to help create a calmer experience for our feline patients.

 


A Practice That Feels Like Home

 


Set within a charming barn conversion, Mainstone is bright, welcoming and thoughtfully designed. We have separate cat and dog waiting areas, three consultation rooms, a dedicated RVN consult room, theatre and prep area, separate X-ray room, cattery and kennels, quiet vet office, fully equipped laboratory, a relaxing staff area, and generous on-site parking.

 


A Team That Supports You

 


You’ll join six vets, six RVNs and a dedicated Client Care Team, including certificate holders in ophthalmology and ECC. We’re an RVN training practice and actively support our team with learning and development, including progression towards clinical certificates.

 

A Rota That Works Around Life

 


The role is 40 hours per week, worked between 8:30am and 7pm, with 1:5 Saturday mornings, 8:30am–12:30pm. There’s no out-of-hours work, and part-time applications over 30+ hours are welcomed.

 


Part of the Romsey Community

 


Community is important to us, from the Romsey Show and Dogstival to local schools, Brownies, open days and the New Forest Show.


Romsey is a charming market town on the edge of the New Forest, offering the perfect blend of countryside living and modern convenience. With independent shops, cafés, riverside walks and excellent local schools, it’s a wonderful place to settle. The nearby New Forest National Park provides endless opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor adventures, while Southampton and Winchester are within easy reach for city amenities and transport links.

 
 

How We’ll Support You

 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership, and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches, and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 
We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.
 
Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

title: Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Anaplan is looking for a <strong>Product Designer</strong> to join our growing global User Experience team based in our Manchester office. You will be a key contributor within our global product organization, collaborating across our hubs in Manchester, San Francisco, London, and beyond.</p> <p>Now is an exciting time to join our UX team of 25+ designers and researchers shaping the future of enterprise planning. We design powerful, data-rich, and intuitive interfaces that help customers make confident business decisions, while defining the next generation of AI-powered experiences across the Anaplan platform. Our work spans core modeling capabilities, intelligent applications, agentic AI experiences, and user-facing planning workflows—all underpinned by a world-class design system.</p> <p>In this role, you will own feature-level product design across the Anaplan platform. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers to solve complex design challenges impacting thousands of enterprise users worldwide. From evolving core planning experiences to contributing to cutting-edge AI capabilities, you'll help build enterprise products that are scalable, accessible, and user-centered from concept through delivery.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul data-tight="undefined"> <li> <p><strong>End-to-End Design:</strong> Design and deliver user-centered solutions for a defined product area, balancing user needs, technical constraints, business goals, and emerging AI capabilities where appropriate.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers throughout the entire product development lifecycle.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Discovery &amp; Research:</strong> Participate in discovery activities including customer interviews, workshops, journey mapping, usability testing, and the exploration of AI-driven user experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Complex Workflow Simplification:</strong> Design intuitive experiences across both traditional enterprise workflows and AI-powered interactions, helping users accomplish complex tasks with confidence.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Prototyping &amp; Artifacts:</strong> Produce high-quality user flows, wireframes, interaction patterns, and interactive prototypes using Figma.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Design System Stewardship:</strong> Work with and contribute to the Anaplan Design System to ensure consistent, accessible, and cohesive product experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Data-Informed Iteration:</strong> Leverage qualitative and quantitative data, customer feedback, and experimentation to validate design decisions and continuously improve experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Champion Best Practices:</strong> Advocate for accessibility (WCAG), usability, and the thoughtful, responsible adoption of AI across the product ecosystem.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul data-tight="undefined"> <li> <p>Professional experience in product design.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong foundation in user-centered design principles and design thinking methodologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven experience designing for data-rich, workflow-heavy interfaces and complex systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>High proficiency in <strong>Figma</strong> and experience working within comprehensive design systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, trade-offs, and rationale clearly to cross-functional partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>A systems-thinking mindset with a passion for high craft, continuous iteration, and constructive feedback.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul data-tight="undefined"> <li> <p>Experience designing for enterprise platforms, including admin, builder, data modeling, or AI-assisted workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to designing AI-powered experiences (e.g., conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, contextual recommendations, or generative AI features).</p> </li> <li> <p>Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how design decisions translate into technical implementation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1+) and inclusive design practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in enterprise SaaS, financial systems, business planning software, or complex B2B solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience operating within Agile, cross-functional product teams.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong></p> <p>This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software at a pivotal moment for Anaplan. You’ll join a collaborative team of talented designers and researchers working on products trusted by many of the world's leading organizations.</p> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex design challenges, influence product direction, and grow your career in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, design excellence, and continuous learning. Whether you're refining core workflows or exploring the frontiers of AI-driven planning, your work will make a measurable impact on thousands of businesses across the globe.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong> &nbsp;</p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not: &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. &nbsp;</li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. &nbsp;</p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: UK New Business Director
description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does an UK- New Business Director do at WPP Production?     The role The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our UK growth function . You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority new business opportunities, designing integrated solutions and clear go-to-market propositions.  You will ensure that every response (whether formal RFP or informal approach) is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all UK pitches , setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production , shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions. Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally . This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team. This is a high-impact role with visibility across the whole UK business, suited to someone who thrives in the fast-paced world of new business, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.   Key areas of responsibility: Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training   What good looks like: Significant experience in new business, client leadership, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions Able to use and apply AI tools to the new business process Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative and production Able to influence and align senior stakeholders, often with competing priorities, to a single direction Experience shaping or evolving go-to-market propositions and strategic positioning Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production #LI-BS2 #LI-Hybrid Why work here:  At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. Inclusion and Impact  WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. Data We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy  st atement . This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. Please contact Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS? Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more. In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR.  We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)  to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges. Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series. Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks. Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software. Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs. Be one of the technical leaders within the team. Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code. Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process. Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions. Maintain and enhance software reliability. WHAT YOU'LL NEED A passion for Motorsport. 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers. A proven track record of building applications in C/C++. Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle. An aptitude for working with complex data. Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers. A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer. Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team. An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities. NICE TO HAVE Degree in computer science or other scientific or technical subject. Prior experience working in motorsport is a strong advantage. An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events. Experience using Catapult's RaceWatch software. Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday. Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio. Experience developing applications that process video. WHY CATAPULT?  We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave. Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do.  In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Senior Integrated Designer - 12 month FTC

Location:  London, United Kingdom  

About the role: 

As Senior Integrated Designer, you'll lead creative thinking and execution across the studio's full channel mix, from initial concept through to final delivery across digital, social, motion, print, and events. You'll bring both ideas and craft to every brief, ensuring work is visually strong, strategically considered, and consistent across touchpoints and markets. 

Operating within a regulated financial services environment, you'll bring discipline to compliance-sensitive materials, set quality benchmarks for the team, embed AI-assisted design workflows, and help build a studio the wider organisation is proud of. 

What you will be doing: 

 Integrated Design & Creative Production 

  • Concept and create on-brand integrated work across the full channel mix, brand campaigns, digital and social content, motion, print, events, marketing collateral, thought leadership, and long-form communications, from brief through to final delivery 
  • Bring integrated thinking to every brief, considering how ideas translate across channels, formats, and markets before execution begins 
  • Produce motion and animation work for digital and social, applying strong storytelling and timing principles alongside visual craft 
  • Adapt integrated design solutions for seven markets and multiple product lines, maintaining visual and conceptual consistency within brand guardrails; prepare all files to correct digital, motion, and print specifications 
  • Manage multiple live projects simultaneously, maintaining brand integrity, quality standards, and deadlines across all output 

 Brand Guardianship & Consistency 

  • Champion consistency of visual identity, tone, and quality across every touchpoint and market, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen brand expression 
  • Apply compliance requirements, disclaimers, substantiation standards, and sign-off checkpoints, as standard practice, with approvals documented correctly 
  • Contribute to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable speed and consistency across the studio 

 Team Leadership & Collaboration 

  • Lead, direct, and mentor the design team, providing clear creative briefs, constructive feedback, and development support that raises capability and output quality across the integrated mix 
  • Work closely with the embedded team and client stakeholders to develop integrated creative ideas, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 

 Gen AI & Agentic Thinking 

  • Apply advanced AI tools to enhance integrated creative output and workflows, building effective prompts, critically evaluating results, and maintaining rigorous human oversight of quality and compliance 
  • Design and embed AI-assisted workflows for the team, setting quality benchmarks and guiding responsible AI use across sizing, adaptation, motion, transcreation, and production efficiency 
  • Break down complex, multi-format creative challenges into clear steps, leading the team to the best outcome efficiently and adapting confidently when priorities shift 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating integrated creative thinking and execution across digital, social, motion, print, and campaign formats, with evidence of both conceptual originality and hands-on craft 
  • Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) and Figma; expert understanding of graphic design, typography, motion, and digital production standards 
  • Proven ability to concept ideas that work across channels, not just adapt static design to new formats 
  • Experience producing motion and animation work for digital and social, with strong storytelling instincts alongside technical execution 
  • Experience producing integrated work for international or multi-market campaigns, adapting design systems across countries and channels within brand guardrails 
  • Deep understanding of brand identity systems, able to apply, protect, and evolve visual standards across a complex, multi-touchpoint portfolio 
  • Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, insurance, or similar), or demonstrated ability to work within compliance, legal, and governance frameworks 
  • Experience contributing to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable consistency and speed across a team 
  • Experience leading and mentoring designers, providing clear creative direction, developmental feedback, and coaching that builds integrated craft capability 
  • Confident presenting and defending integrated creative concepts to senior stakeholders, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 
  • Advanced use of AI tools relevant to integrated design, building effective workflows, evaluating outputs critically, and training others in responsible AI use 
  • Agentic mindset: able to lead a team through complex, multi-format creative challenges, adapting confidently when priorities shift and maintaining quality under pressure
  • Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning.
