Role:  Global Head of Analytics

Location:  London, United Kingdom  (2-3 days a week from our London offices)

 

About the role: 

We're looking for a Global Head of Analytics to lead one of the most important practices in our business. This is a senior leadership role with genuine scope; you'll own a global team of around 80 people, spanning audience insight, creative performance analytics, social listening and measurement, search marketing and paid social, all embedded within in-house client teams across Europe, APAC, LATAM and North America. 

Reporting to OLIVER's Chief Strategy Officer, you'll sit at the intersection of creativity, technology and data. You'll help OLIVER and our clients understand not just what's performing, but why, and what to do next. You'll spearhead new solutions in driving creative effectiveness, and proving the value of the creative component of our clients' marketing. 

You'll work closely with Brandtech colleagues in packaging and scaling Group data solutions to drive more value from marketing. 

You'll also play a key role, with your Brandtech colleagues, in shaping how our proprietary Gen AI platform, Pencil, is powered by data and insight; making it smarter, faster and more impactful for the clients who rely on it. 

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a client boardroom as they are in a product sprint. Someone who can inspire a globally distributed team, spot commercial opportunity and translate complex data into stories that help businesses make better decisions. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead and develop the global analytics practice
    • Provide leadership to a globally distributed team of ~80 analysts and insight specialists, with six direct reports across disciplines and regions
    • Build and sustain a high-performance, collaborative team culture across a diverse, multi-disciplinary group
    • Define and continuously evolve OLIVER's analytics methodologies, tools and frameworks across search, paid social, social listening, audience insight and measurement — ensuring best practice is shared and applied globally
    • Ensure the team has the engineering capability to integrate data sources and build automated solutions at scale
    • Champion data and insight as a strategic differentiator — internally at OLIVER and externally with clients
  • Drive commercial growth
    • Own the analytics revenue line, accountable for delivering 10% year-on-year growth
    • Identify and develop new commercial opportunities: expanding services within existing client relationships and contributing to new business pitches
    • Work with senior client stakeholders to demonstrate and quantify the value of data-led decision-making
    • Act as a senior analytics partner and thought leader for key clients — particularly on creative effectiveness, audience understanding and performance measurement
    • Drive meaningful improvement in client satisfaction, targeting a five-point improvement in client NPS in year one
  • Build and launch new products
    • Partner with data and technology leaders across the Brandtech Group to co-develop proprietary data products and analytics capabilities, with a focus on the creative effectiveness space
    • Package and position Brandtech's data assets in ways that are compelling and value-driving for OLIVER's clients — particularly at the intersection of media, creativity and agentic commerce
    • Lead the scaling of OLIVER's Gen AI-enabled data products, including trend and competitor reporting tools and automated social reporting
    • Scale OLIVER's creative effectiveness measurement approach into a differentiating, client-facing capability
  • Embed Gen AI at the heart of insight
    • Play a central role in ensuring Pencil, Brandtech's proprietary Gen AI platform, is optimally enabled by data and insight
    • Stay at the frontier of Gen AI developments relevant to marketing analytics — bringing new ideas and applications into the business
    • Work with OLIVER's wider leadership team to embed AI-powered insight into client workflows and content ecosystems
  • Shape group-wide data strategy
    • Build strong relationships with Brandtech Group data leaders, contributing to group-wide thinking on data strategy and product development
    • Lead thinking on how media, creativity and data come together — and how LLM recommendation and agentic commerce will reshape content ecosystems

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Significant senior leadership experience in analytics, data strategy or a related discipline, ideally within a creative or media agency, platform, or technology business
  • A track record of building and scaling high-performing, multi-disciplinary analytics teams in a global or multi-market context
  • Demonstrable success growing revenue and commercialising data or insight propositions
  • Experience developing and launching data products or insight tools, ideally in collaboration with technology partners
  • Deep familiarity with the marketing analytics landscape: performance measurement, audience insight, social listening, search, paid social and creative effectiveness
  • Exceptional strategic thinking — the ability to connect data to business outcomes in ways that resonate with C-suite and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong commercial instincts: experienced in identifying, shaping and closing revenue opportunities
  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills — able to make complex data feel clear, relevant and actionable
  • Ability to lead and inspire distributed, culturally diverse teams across multiple time zones
  • Experienced in navigating and influencing complex, matrixed organisations
  • Sets the AI strategy for the analytics discipline across OLIVER's global portfolio
  • Genuine fluency in Gen AI and its applications in marketing and data — including hands-on experience building agents and agentic workflows
  • Develops AI capability across teams and client offerings; embeds AI-powered insight into client workflows at scale
  • Leads governance and quality standards for AI-assisted analytics across the practice
  • Contributes thought leadership on AI's role in data, creativity and marketing — internally across Brandtech and externally in the industry
  • Accountability for the analytics revenue line and year-on-year growth targets
  • Experience building and presenting commercial propositions from data and insight capabilities
  • P&L management experience across multiple markets or business lines
  • Track record of presenting financial performance to executive and board-level stakeholders
  •  Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, independent research, or professional practice.

This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Adaptabilité :  capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouvelles technologies et à comprendre les enjeux métier. title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, <span data-highlighted="true" data-vc="highlighted-text"><span class="_kqswh2mm"><span class="_5pioz8co _189e1dm9 _1il9buyh _19lc184f _d0altlke" data-testid="definition-highlighter">DBT</span></span></span>, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership</li> <li>Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL</li> <li>Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques</li> <li>Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders</li> <li>Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations</li> <li>Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack</li> </ul> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools</li> <li>Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly</li> <li>Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture</li> <li>Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems</li> <li>Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.</li> <li><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to&nbsp;<a class="underline underline underline-offset-2 decoration-1 decoration-current/40 hover:decoration-current focus:decoration-current" href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI</li> <li>Background working with regulated or governed data</li> <li>Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€46.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€65.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Czechia</div><div class="pay-range"><span>867 000 Kč</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>1 598 000 Kč CZK</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£49,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£55,500 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">France</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$54,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$65,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&nbsp;</em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;<br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;<br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients.&nbsp;Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Certifié Ecovadis Or et SBTi (Science Based Targets initiative) pour sa stratégie de réduction carbone, WPP France s'engage depuis plus de 20 ans dans une démarche active de développement durable. Avec plus de 2 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 14 agences en France, le groupe œuvre à intégrer les enjeux environnementaux et sociétaux au cœur de ses activités.</p> <p>En rejoignant nos équipes, vous contribuerez à poursuivre cette dynamique en collaboration avec l'équipe locale, tout en soutenant la direction de la communication dans ses initiatives stratégiques et ses prises de parole institutionnelles. Vous participerez à des projets d'impact positif, en lien avec les valeurs de durabilité et d'innovation qui animent WPP France.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <p><em>Sustainability</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Participer</strong>&nbsp;à la coordination des projets de WPP sur les sujets d’impact et collaborer avec les équipes déjà investies sur ces thématiques (ressources humaines, juridique, communication interne, conseil client, etc.).</li> <li><strong>Travailler</strong>&nbsp;en direct avec l’équipe internationale et l’équipe France, incluant les référents RSE de chaque agence.</li> <li><strong>Concevoir</strong>&nbsp;et/ou mettre à jour la documentation pour acculturer et sensibiliser les collaborateurs du groupe sur les enjeux RSE, tout en veillant à l’application des meilleures pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Gérer</strong>&nbsp;et coordonner les "Impact Teams" pour renforcer les initiatives internes.</li> <li><strong>Participer</strong>&nbsp;à la proposition d’offres d’accompagnement RSE destinées aux clients.</li> <li><strong>Appuyer</strong>&nbsp;le déploiement des formations internes liées aux enjeux RSE.</li> </ul> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Communication du groupe / Événements internes</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Soutenir</strong>&nbsp;la gestion et l’organisation des événements du groupe, incluant la gestion des invitations et la préparation logistique.</li> <li><strong>Épauler</strong>&nbsp;la Directrice Communication de WPP dans la création, l’éditorialisation et la diffusion des communications internes et externes.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac +4/+5 avec une spécialisation ou des compétences avérées en RSE, une appétence pour la communication sera un réel atout.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong>&nbsp;Une première expérience (stage ou projet académique) en gestion de projet, idéalement avec une dimension environnementale ou sociétale.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong>&nbsp;Un fort intérêt pour le secteur de la publicité, des médias et des nouvelles technologies (incluant l'intelligence artificielle).</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong>&nbsp;Maîtrise de l'anglais indispensable (niveau B2 à C2) pour interagir avec les équipes internationales.</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong>&nbsp;Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet et de création de présentations.</li> <li><strong>Expertise métier :</strong>&nbsp;Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication, associées à un esprit critique et une forte capacité d'analyse.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Rigueur :</strong>&nbsp;Une haute attention aux détails pour garantir la qualité des livrables et des communications.</li> <li><strong>Organisation :</strong>&nbsp;Excellente gestion du temps et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multiples et transverses.</li> <li><strong>Proactivité :</strong>&nbsp;Curiosité, enthousiasme et force de proposition pour faire avancer les sujets environnementaux et sociétaux.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas&nbsp;!</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3&nbsp;!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

gestión Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA a procesos empresariales Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. description: <h3><strong>Who we are</strong></h3> <p>Artefact is a French consulting and engineering firm specializing in data and AI, and a leader in Europe. Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 23 countries across all continents, with a team of 1,700 employees.</p> <p>Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing tailor-made solutions that address their specific industry challenges. As pioneers in this field, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working alongside the world's leading market players. Our clients span all key economic sectors - industry, retail, luxury, consumer goods, healthcare, and finance - and include major international corporations.</p> <h3><strong>The Data Analytics Team</strong></h3> <p>You will join our Data Analytics Chapter, a team of 60 professionals with expertise across dashboarding, analytics engineering, marketing measurement, and low-code data science. We are one of three technical teams at Artefact (alongside Software Engineering and Data Science), forming a tech community of 160 people. Despite working on different client engagements, we maintain a strong culture of knowledge sharing through dedicated communities of practice. We are growing fast, with the ambition to double our team size over the next five years.</p> <h3><strong>What you will be doing - Key responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform our clients' businesses through effective data collection, processing, and visualization, acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders.</p> <h4><strong>Delivering end-to-end analytics projects</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Frame use cases with business teams, validate data availability, and define the right approach.</li> <li>Design and implement dashboards, data products, and pipelines that drive business decision-making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Driving technical excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Translate business requirements into scalable analytics architectures and pipelines.</li> <li>Apply modern analytics engineering practices and promote best practices in data modeling and testing.</li> <li>Leveraging the latest GenAI developments in order to deliver the maximum value possible for our clients</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Being a trusted advisor</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extract valuable insights and communicate them in clear, actionable terms.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a go-to expert for analytics guidance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Contributing to team development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor junior data analysts and share best practices through workshops and documentation.</li> <li>Contribute to internal accelerators and maintain active technology watch.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Qualifications - What we are looking for</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for profiles with deep expertise in one of the following domains, combined with openness to work across others. Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

As a Performance Software Engineer, you will be instrumental in building the core computation software that runs on Arago’s custom AI accelerators. Your work will bridge the gap between host systems and proprietary hardware, encompassing everything from a custom on-board kernels to the sophisticated tooling required for real-time debugging. You will be a key player in chip bring-up and the long-term development of high-performance computation primitives and kernels, ensuring our architecture operates with maximum efficiency and deterministic performance.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong experience in low-level systems programming using C/C++ and assembly, with excellent understanding of how compiled software maps to machine instructions and hardware behavior.

  • Deep familiarity with bare-metal development, including startup code, linker scripts, memory layout, MMIO, interrupts/exceptions, timers, synchronization, and direct peripheral access.

  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, including pipelines, caches, memory hierarchies, virtual/physical addressing, atomics, DMA, and performance implications of different access patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with RISC-V and/or ARM architectures, instruction sets, calling conventions, ABI concepts, and architecture-specific intrinsics.

  • Experience debugging hardware/software interactions using tools such as GDB, JTAG, trace/debug interfaces, simulators, emulators, or FPGA platforms.

  • Ability to read hardware specifications, register descriptions, and RTL-level documentation and translate them into robust software implementations.

  • Strong performance-analysis and optimization skills, including profiling, disassembly inspection, compiler optimization behavior, and hand-tuned assembly where appropriate.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize low-level software primitives in C/C++, assembly, and architecture-specific intrinsics, primarily for RISC-V and ARM platforms.

  • Implement performance-critical kernels, runtime components, hardware abstraction layers, drivers, and firmware operating in bare-metal or highly constrained environments.

  • Work closely with hardware architects and RTL/design teams to define and validate hardware-software interfaces, memory maps, register interfaces, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, and boot flows.

  • Analyze and optimize software for latency, throughput, memory footprint, instruction count, and efficient use of processor and accelerator features.

  • Bring up and debug software on simulation, emulation, FPGA, and silicon platforms, including low-level hardware/software integration issues.

  • Develop validation tests, benchmarks, and diagnostic tools for new processor, DSP, accelerator, and SoC functionality.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions around ISA extensions, compiler intrinsics, memory hierarchy, DMA, cache/coherency behavior, and software-visible hardware features.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (10 countries, 450+ experts from 50+ nationalities)

  • We are becoming an agentic organization, adopting the AI-native operating model we bring to our clients

  • We are robust and resilient (100% independent, 0 debt, founded 2009)

  • We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

  • We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

As Head of Engineering at PALO IT Labs, reporting directly to the CTO, you are the operational engine of our engineering organisation. You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. You own the day-to-day: team health, engineering standards, roadmap execution, and the development of our AI engineers. You are the technical authority your teams rely on to unblock, challenge and grow-while the CTO focuses on vision, key clients, and long-term positioning.

Engineering Excellence

  • Deploy the Gen-e²™ technology roadmap defined by the CTO: architecture governance, AI governance, and factory standards (agents, prompts, rules, pipelines) across all squads

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Deploy on our most complex client engagements as the senior technical authority: design AI-first architectures and see them through to production-you ship, not slide decks

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: CI/CD practices, code reviews, incident management, and security posture across squads

  • Own technical incidents and escalations with clear ownership and post-mortems

People & Community

  • Directly manage Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and later AI tech leads and - their growth, performance, workload and career paths are yours

  • Own the engineering community’s rituals end to end: critiques, showcases, community days, learning circles and the shared knowledge base that keeps them visible, inclusive and connected to real delivery challenges

  • Foster cross-project collaboration by connecting engineers facing similar challenges, surfacing reusable patterns, and turning field learnings into shared standards

  • Set the community’s norms and health signals: champion psychological safety, experimentation, wellbeing and sustainable pace, and run lightweight pulse checks to catch issues early

  • Build the mentorship engine: create structures and learning pathways for Senior Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers, and grow the technical leadership bench

  • Operate the hiring process for engineering roles: sourcing strategy, interviews, technical assessments and recommendations to the CTO

  • Partner with delivery and staffing teams to maintain visibility of capacity and utilisation, support staffing decisions, and turn bench time into meaningful learning, R&D or community contribution

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You are fluent at every altitude, from engineering stand-ups to leadership forums, and you switch between them in the same afternoon

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

  • Nice to have: cloud architecture certifications (AWS SA, GCP/Azure Professional), public speaking or publications on AI-first delivery

More About PALO IT 

Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company when it comes to AI-First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects are focused on deploying our Gen-e2 methodology to clients to help them accelerate delivery and scale those new practices. 

 

  • A playground matching your expertise: missions chosen for their complexity, engineering excellence, and meaningful business and societal impact.

  • Dedicated career coaching with regular development check-ins and goal support.

  • A demanding yet supportive technical community: code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily.

  • Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding.

  • Funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications.

  • From idea to impact: internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share.

 

…Plus

  • 🌍 Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide.

  • 🏠 Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and Paris office for team collaboration.

  • 🌱 Impact Academy: training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices.

  • 🤝 Solidarity engagements: team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more.

  • 🥗🩺 Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance.

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page. 

PALO IT Labs is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities. PALO IT Labs does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexuality, national origin, age, disability, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law. 

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data are longstanding top priorities for PALO IT. Your data will be processed to manage PALO IT’s recruitment-related activities. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.palo-it.com/en/privacy-policy) to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

description: Qui sommes-nous? Construire. Développer. Pérenniser. Nous sommes un cabinet de conseil technologique mondial avec une approche d'ingénierie axée sur l’IA , déposée en marque, pour accélérer la livraison de produits numériques et révolutionner la modernisation des plateformes. Nous faisons ce qui est juste, et nous le faisons bien. Nous sommes fiers d’être parmi les New Champions du Forum Économique Mondial et une entreprise certifiée B Corp. · Nous sommes assez petits pour agir localement, assez grands pour livrer globalement (5 continents, 11 bureaux, plus de 500 experts de plus de 50 nationalités) · Nous sommes solides et résilients (100 % indépendants et sans dette) · Nous sommes entrepreneurs et experts passionnés : nous investissons dans ce en quoi nous croyons sincèrement et travaillons en intelligence collective · Nous sommes positifs, courageux, attentionnés, acteurs et engagés pour l’excellence Gen-e2 Alors que le marché se contente encore largement de livraisons simplement « augmentées par l’IA », nous avons réinventé le cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC) pour le rendre AI First . Notre approche change la donne en matière de productivité et de qualité, grâce à une collaboration étroite entre l’IA générative et nos meilleurs talents : Nous générons désormais 95 % de l’ensemble du produit — code, documentation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et même le design, le tout propulsé par GitHub Copilot. Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles , tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie. Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering. Votre rôle Pour notre filiale PALO IT LABS basée à Paris et entièrement axée sur le développement de notre méthodologie Gen-e2 , vous serez amené à utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe pour accélérer les cycles de développement et stimuler l’innovation. En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA , de la phase de découverte à la livraison . Vous serez responsable de l’excellence technique, du développement des compétences de l’équipe et du succès client , en veillant à ce que chaque projet soit aligné avec le modèle Gen-e2 speed-to-impact. En tant qu’ AI Native Lead Architect, vos missions principales seront : Leadership technique & Architecture Définir les périmètres de services et les architectures de référence, en alignement avec les SLOs, les politiques de sécurité et les objectifs d’optimisation des coûts. Piloter le contexte engineering (fonctionnel et technique) au sein du référentiel produit, en garantissant transparence et qualité via des templates PR automatisés et le respect des normes documentaires. Réaliser des analyses de risques et menaces , en arbitrant entre performances, confidentialité, durabilité et sécurité. Concevoir et mettre en place des garde-fous dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex. anonymisation des données sensibles, vérification des licences, gates de conformité) pour garantir une qualité de niveau entreprise. Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes. Engagement collaboratif Faciliter la collaboration avec les sponsors techniques et les équipes produit , en tant que référent d’expertise technique. Participer aux phases de pitch, proof-of-concept et développement de l’écosystème et des artefacts . Coaching & Facilitation du changement Mentorer et guider les équipes de développement, favorisant une culture d'apprentissage et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation tout en garantissant le delivery du développement technique . Participer aux revues de code, en fournissant des r etours constructifs et des suggestions d'amélioration . Rester informé(e) des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques, et évaluer leur impact potentiel sur les opérations commerciales et la performance de l’équipe. Vous êtes au bon endroit si Vous êtes un(e) architecte logiciel et Tech Lead confirmé(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à intégrer les méthodes IA-First dans des solutions techniques robustes et scalables. Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en architecture et développement logiciel (Java, .net, Python, React, Angular...) et IA, avec une appétence forte pour la technique et une capacité à être hands-on; Une forte expertise dans la conception et le scaling d’applications cloud-native ou d’architectures AI-First; Une maîtrise approfondie des processus CI/CD, des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), des technologies de containerisation, et des pratiques DevSecOps; Une familiarité avec les approches UX-as-Code et la pensée design system; Une capacité à accompagner et mentorer des équipes diverses dans le développement et l’implémentation de solutions techniques; Un anglais fluide et d’excellentes capacités de communication auprès d’audiences techniques comme non techniques. Vous avez une pensée critique et analytique pour valider et vérifier le code et les solutions générés par l’IA ; Vous avez une volonté permanente d’apprendre et de vous tenir informé de l’évolution rapide du paysage de l’IA ; Vous êtes sensible aux questions sociales, environnementales et Tech For Good et les intégrez dans ce que vous construisez ; Les profils de nos consultantes et consultants sont tous diversifiés, et nous sommes fier.es de cette richesse. raw.description:
Qui sommes-nous?


Construire. Développer. Pérenniser.

Nous sommes un cabinet de conseil technologique mondial avec une approche d'ingénierie axée sur l’IA, déposée en marque, pour accélérer la livraison de produits numériques et révolutionner la modernisation des plateformes. Nous faisons ce qui est juste, et nous le faisons bien. Nous sommes fiers d’être parmi les New Champions du Forum Économique Mondial et une entreprise certifiée B Corp.

· Nous sommes assez petits pour agir localement, assez grands pour livrer globalement (5 continents, 11 bureaux, plus de 500 experts de plus de 50 nationalités)
· Nous sommes solides et résilients (100 % indépendants et sans dette)
· Nous sommes entrepreneurs et experts passionnés : nous investissons dans ce en quoi nous croyons sincèrement et travaillons en intelligence collective
· Nous sommes positifs, courageux, attentionnés, acteurs et engagés pour l’excellence

Gen-e2

Alors que le marché se contente encore largement de livraisons simplement « augmentées par l’IA », nous avons réinventé le cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC) pour le rendre AI First. Notre approche change la donne en matière de productivité et de qualité, grâce à une collaboration étroite entre l’IA générative et nos meilleurs talents :

  • Nous générons désormais 95 % de l’ensemble du produit — code, documentation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et même le design, le tout propulsé par GitHub Copilot.

  • Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles, tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie.

    Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering.

Votre rôle

Pour notre filiale PALO IT LABS basée à Paris et entièrement axée sur le développement de notre méthodologie Gen-e2, vous serez amené à utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe pour accélérer les cycles de développement et stimuler l’innovation.

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA, de la phase de découverte à la livraison. Vous serez responsable de l’excellence technique, du développement des compétences de l’équipe et du succès client, en veillant à ce que chaque projet soit aligné avec le modèle Gen-e2 speed-to-impact.


En tant qu’AI Native Lead Architect, vos missions principales seront :

Leadership technique & Architecture

  • Définir les périmètres de services et les architectures de référence, en alignement avec les SLOs, les politiques de sécurité et les objectifs d’optimisation des coûts.

  • Piloter le contexte engineering (fonctionnel et technique) au sein du référentiel produit, en garantissant transparence et qualité via des templates PR automatisés et le respect des normes documentaires.

  • Réaliser des analyses de risques et menaces, en arbitrant entre performances, confidentialité, durabilité et sécurité.

  • Concevoir et mettre en place des garde-fous dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex. anonymisation des données sensibles, vérification des licences, gates de conformité) pour garantir une qualité de niveau entreprise.

  • Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes.
     

Engagement collaboratif

  • Faciliter la collaboration avec les sponsors techniques et les équipes produit, en tant que référent d’expertise technique.

  • Participer aux phases de pitch, proof-of-concept et développement de l’écosystème et des artefacts. 
     

Coaching & Facilitation du changement

  • Mentorer et guider les équipes de développement, favorisant une culture d'apprentissage et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation tout en garantissant le delivery du développement technique.

  • Participer aux revues de code, en fournissant des retours constructifs et des suggestions d'amélioration.

  • Rester informé(e) des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques, et évaluer leur impact potentiel sur les opérations commerciales et la performance de l’équipe.

Vous êtes au bon endroit si

  • Vous êtes un(e) architecte logiciel et Tech Lead confirmé(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à intégrer les méthodes IA-First dans des solutions techniques robustes et scalables.

  • Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en architecture et développement logiciel (Java, .net, Python, React, Angular...) et IA, avec une appétence forte pour la technique et une capacité à être hands-on;

  • Une forte expertise dans la conception et le scaling d’applications cloud-native ou d’architectures AI-First;

  • Une maîtrise approfondie des processus CI/CD, des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), des technologies de containerisation, et des pratiques DevSecOps;

  • Une familiarité avec les approches UX-as-Code et la pensée design system;

  • Une capacité à accompagner et mentorer des équipes diverses dans le développement et l’implémentation de solutions techniques;

  • Un anglais fluide et d’excellentes capacités de communication auprès d’audiences techniques comme non techniques.

  • Vous comprenez des principes de prompt engineering pour une interaction optimale des outils d’IA ;

  • Vous avez une connaissance et curiosité élevées des technologies IA/ML, incluant OpenAI API, LangChain, Hugging Face et le context engineering.

  • Vous avez une pensée critique et analytique pour valider et vérifier le code et les solutions générés par l’IA ;

  • Vous avez une volonté permanente d’apprendre et de vous tenir informé de l’évolution rapide du paysage de l’IA ;

  • Vous êtes sensible aux questions sociales, environnementales et Tech For Good et les intégrez dans ce que vous construisez ;

Les profils de nos consultantes et consultants sont tous diversifiés, et nous sommes fier.es de cette richesse. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si votre profil ne répond pas à 100 % à cette annonce, nous valorisons également:

  • Le partage de votre engagement, vos connaissances techniques, votre volonté et votre enthousiasme dans des conférences ou communautés de développement et de Software Craftsmanship ;

  • Votre participation à un ou plusieurs projets Open Source, en tant que contributeur.rice, par exemple ;

  • Votre passion pour l'éco-conception, les défis sociaux modernes, l’innovation dans les domaines humains et le développement durable ;

  • Votre engagement dans des associations ou meetups autour de l’humain et de l’environnement.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un terrain de jeu à la hauteur de votre expertise: des missions sélectionnées pour leur complexité, leur exigence d’ingénierie et leur impact business et sociétal.

  • Un coach de carrière dédié qui vous accompagne avec des séances régulières pour structurer, suivre et accélérer vos objectifs de développement.

  • Une communauté technique exigeante et bienveillante: revues de code, pair programming, partage et mentoring pour élever en continu le craft et la rigueur.

  • Parcours de montée en compétences Gen-e2 dès la semaine 1 et tout au long de votre onboarding.

  • Des certifications Microsoft et GitHub financées dès l’onboarding.

  • De l’idée au partage: lab R&D interne, open source by default, conférences tech et dojos d’innovation pour expérimenter, coder, transmettre.

Mais également

  • 🌍 Carrière globale, missions multi-secteurs et potentiellement multi-pays, passerelles entre 11 bureaux.

  • 🏠 Remote Friendly en fonction du projet, les jours en présentiel se vivent chez les clients ou dans nos bureaux à République, Paris avec des réunions d'équipe pour partager et innover. Des missions en full présentiel pourront être déployées. 

  • 🌱 Impact Academy formations climat, numérique responsable et accessibilité intégrées à nos pratiques.

  • 🤝 Engagement solidaire volontariats en équipe, mécénat de compétences.

  • 🥗🩺 Swile pour les tickets resto, Alan pour une santé bien couverte.

Chez PALO IT, la diversité est source d'innovation et d'impact. En tant que B Corp, nous offrons l'égalité des chances et évaluons les candidats uniquement sur leurs compétences, leur potentiel et leur motivation. Nous accueillons les candidatures sans distinction d'identité ou d'expression de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, d'origine, d'ethnie, de religion, de handicap ou de tout autre attribut protégé.

We are now looking for a head of data to develop the Data function at Luo, and to enable every team to leverage data in their day-to-day operations and decisions. What you will build will impact every department: finance, operations, product, sales, FX trading, treasury. The role As head of data, you have three core mandates. You work closely with the engineering team to help evolve our databases and decide data models.   • Make the business teams autonomous. Document data models and train managers to query data within their respective scopes.

  • Review every schema change before it ships, arbitrate the data consequences of product decisions, and guarantee that no existing dashboard or reporting pipeline breaks on product releases.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience working in data.

  • Strong SQL expertise. In-depth experience with Postgres is highly appreciated.

  • Strong data tooling experience.

  • Experience with dbt, BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform data ecosystem is appreciated.

  • Experience with fintech data is appreciated (eg. multi-currency systems, FX exchanges, ledger systems, balance logic and financial reconciliations).

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to create clarity around complex data problems.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

raw.title: 📱 Fullstack Developer
raw.description:
🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

  • Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)

In the meantime, meet Robin, our CTO & Head of Product:

title: Medical Excellence
description: Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe The mission At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the operating system for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. The role Lucis analyses more than 110 biomarkers, builds personalised clinical protocols, and delivers them through an AI-powered preventive health product. As Medical Excellence, you are the senior medical expert next to product and Medical ops. You bring deep clinical expertise into protocols, ranges, evidence, and what we can say next to a marker. You also cover medical content: biomarker copy, protocols, and marketing clinical sign-off. You work with the product lead, Medical ops, medical reviewers, and AI. You do not own product decisions, and you do not own labs, partners, or turnaround — Medical ops does. This is not a traditional bedside role. It is not an ops role. It is not a copywriting role. You have practiced medicine in depth, and you can turn clinical judgment into clear protocols, ranges, and member-facing language. What you own Protocols & clinical standards Protocol logic, decision trees, clinical rules Biomarker thresholds and expert ranges Translate medical reasoning into structures the product and Medical ops can run Keep protocols aligned with current evidence Support new biomarkers, health systems, and preventive programmes from the clinical side Evidence & clinical judgment Evidence bar: what we should test, drop, or claim Brief product and the team without a 40-page memo Clinical review of edge cases and sensitive outputs Review of AI-generated medical outputs for clinical accuracy and safety Medical content Biomarker explanations, protocol rationales, in-product clinical language Coach / member-facing clinical copy Marketing clinical sign-off French and English at publication quality Keep member-facing clinical language trustworthy Medical quality and governance Clinical review and sign-off processes (clinical side: what must be medically signed off, and to what standard) Quality-control systems, documentation standards, audit trails — in partnership with Medical ops Escalation and medical risk-management processes — clinical criteria and judgment Clinical performance indicators — definition of medical quality bars, with Medical ops on measurement and ops About you You are a doctor with substantial clinical practice. raw.title: Medical Excellence
raw.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the operating system for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives.

The role

Lucis analyses more than 110 biomarkers, builds personalised clinical protocols, and delivers them through an AI-powered preventive health product.

As Medical Excellence, you are the senior medical expert next to product and Medical ops. You bring deep clinical expertise into protocols, ranges, evidence, and what we can say next to a marker. You also cover medical content: biomarker copy, protocols, and marketing clinical sign-off.

You work with the product lead, Medical ops, medical reviewers, and AI. You do not own product decisions, and you do not own labs, partners, or turnaround — Medical ops does.

This is not a traditional bedside role. It is not an ops role. It is not a copywriting role. You have practiced medicine in depth, and you can turn clinical judgment into clear protocols, ranges, and member-facing language.

What you own

Protocols & clinical standards

  • Protocol logic, decision trees, clinical rules

  • Biomarker thresholds and expert ranges

  • Translate medical reasoning into structures the product and Medical ops can run

  • Keep protocols aligned with current evidence

  • Support new biomarkers, health systems, and preventive programmes from the clinical side

Evidence & clinical judgment

  • Evidence bar: what we should test, drop, or claim

  • Brief product and the team without a 40-page memo

  • Clinical review of edge cases and sensitive outputs

  • Review of AI-generated medical outputs for clinical accuracy and safety

Medical content

  • Biomarker explanations, protocol rationales, in-product clinical language

  • Coach / member-facing clinical copy

  • Marketing clinical sign-off

  • French and English at publication quality

  • Keep member-facing clinical language trustworthy

Medical quality and governance

  • Clinical review and sign-off processes (clinical side: what must be medically signed off, and to what standard)

  • Quality-control systems, documentation standards, audit trails — in partnership with Medical ops

  • Escalation and medical risk-management processes — clinical criteria and judgment

  • Clinical performance indicators — definition of medical quality bars, with Medical ops on measurement and ops

About you

You are a doctor with substantial clinical practice. You care that what members read and what protocols encode is medically sound. You are comfortable working with product and AI without needing to run either. You write like a clinician people would trust.

You’ll fit in well if

  • You hold an MD (preferred) with deep clinical practice — more experience than a junior reviewer

  • Prevention, internal medicine, nutrition, functional, cardiology, public health, or a related field is a plus

  • You have strong clinical judgement, case by case and when defining standards

  • You can set protocol logic, ranges, and an evidence bar other people can execute

  • You write clearly in French and English at publication quality

  • You work well with product, Medical ops, AI, and reviewers — without owning their roadmaps

  • You balance medical rigour with pragmatism

  • You take ownership beyond a narrow specialty lane

We might not be a fit if

  • You want to focus primarily on traditional bedside practice

  • You want to run labs, partners, turnaround, or ops queues (that’s Medical ops)

  • You want to own the product roadmap

  • You prefer pure research or citation work without shipping clinical standards

  • You are a copywriter without real clinical practice

  • You need every process already defined before you contribute

  • You prioritise predictable nine-to-five work over mission intensity

Practical details

  • Format: Full-time preferred. Flexible for the right senior profile.

  • Location: Paris mostly / Europe

  • Languages: French and English required. Additional language a plus.

  • Relocation support possible. Europe-based candidates welcome if willing to travel regularly to Paris.

The process

  1. Introductory call (20 minutes)

  2. Technical interview (30–60 minutes) — clinical judgement, protocol/evidence thinking, writing sample or case

  3. At-home case study (within two days)

  4. Deep dive and team conversations in Paris

  5. Reference calls
